system.description: A 20th level, 18 Intelligence wizard makes a crystal bull with ESP. That requires two spell effects— clairvoyance and ESP. The initial enchantment cost is 5,000 gp (one is a 3rd level spell and the other is 2nd level; 1,000 gp x total number of spell levels). The wizard must roll for chance of success for both spells.
